title: Slovakian Zesty Pork Bake
description: A hearty and flavorful Slovakian dish featuring pork, zesty ingredients, and a crispy bake.
instructions: Season the pork shoulder with garlic powder, black pepper, and thyme.
In a small bowl, mix together zesty mustard, caraway seeds, and olive oil.
Brush the mustard mixture evenly over the pork shoulder.
Roll the pork shoulder in dense bread crumbs, pressing gently to adhere.
Place the pork shoulder in a baking dish and roast for 20 minutes.
Reduce oven temperature to 375°F (190°C) and continue roasting for an additional 20-25 minutes, or until the internal temperature reaches 160°F (71°C).
Let the pork rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
